meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在触发时执行旧版记忆迁移：先暂停任务并重启群组，把旧记忆文件移到暂存区，再整理进共享记忆树，生成来源报告，最后验证并恢复任务。
howto.when: 当更新报告共享记忆破坏性更改，或群组中仍有 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等旧版记忆文件时触发；用户说‘migrate memory’等关键词也会触发。

say.text: 请迁移我的旧版记忆文件。
我切换后助手忘了所有事情。
把 CLAUDE.md 合并到新记忆系统吧。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude, when triggered, will pause tasks and restart the group, move legacy memory files into a staging area, organize them into the shared memory tree, produce a source report, verify, and then resume tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggers after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, CLAUDE.md, or other legacy memory files; also when the user says 'migrate memory' or similar keywords.

say_en.text: Please migrate my legacy memory files.
The agent forgot everything after the switch.
Could you merge CLAUDE.md into the new memory system?
